title: Houses and renovations, Brisbane: house roofing
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Re-roof a two storey house
swms.task: Remove the concrete roof tiles from a two storey house and replace them with metal roof sheeting, with the sheets lifted by the crane company's mobile crane.

facts.craneCompany: Lifts are done by the crane company under its lift plan; its dogman slings and releases the loads, and our crew receives them with tag lines.
facts.fallControl: Roof edge protection is installed by the scaffolder around the whole roof before the tiles are removed, and checked before work starts each day.
facts.controlsConsidered: Edge protection and scaffolds were considered first for every task, and an elevating work platform where they cannot be fixed.

steps: Set up roof access and fall protection
Lift materials to and from the roof
Plan lifts with the crane company
Work with the crane crew during lifts
